Trace, implement and test: Library Interface Demo

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class LibraryInterfaceDemo {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        KidUsers kid = new KidUsers();
        AdultUsers adult = new AdultUsers();

        kid.setAge(10);
        kid.setBookType("Kids");
        kid.registerAccount();
        kid.requestBook();

        System.out.println();

        adult.setAge(22);
        adult.setBookType("Fiction");
        adult.registerAccount();
        adult.requestBook();

    }
}
